entry.summary:
Council encourages residents to have their say and provide feedback on the following topics, which are currently open for submissions through the consultation and engagement process. 

Simplifying Local Government Reform - what will best serve Kawerau into the future?

Thank you for your feedback received as part of the Simplifying Local Government reform. Council has received more than 220 online surveys, and a good number of written submissions that we are currently processing. Government hasbeen proposing a reform of local government with announcements in November 2025, and again on 5 May 2026 which accelerated the process. The Simplifying Local Government reform aims to:

  • Reduce the number of councils in New Zealand 
  • Remove regional councils by October 2028  
  • Simplify local government functions (like planning, regulatory, consenting) in line with the resource management reform 

Recent Government announcements on 5 May 2026 make it clear that the status quo for all councils is not an option. There is an option of a Head Start pathway giving councils the option of putting forward proposals for how local government should be reorganised in the future.

Councils have until 9 August 2026 to submit a Head Start proposal which must be submitted by two or more councils. 

The timeline is tight, but we want our community to provide feedback on which district/s you think will serve Kawerau best into the future. There are a number of options to consider such as: 

  • Merging with our neighbours for an Eastern Bay sub-regional unitary authority that will keep representation, governance, decisions and accountability closer to home. This aligns Kawerau with more rural-focused communities with similar interests. The Eastern Bay already has an integrated workforce, connected communities and cultural ties, and our Councils have existing synergies and shared services to expand upon;
  • Merging with district or city councils within the Bay of Plenty region to provide better scale of efficiencies and potential cost savings. 

Council engagement on the Simplifying Local Government reform -

As at 13 July 2026

  • Early conversations during Mahere ā Tau Annual Plan 2026-2027 engagement in April/May ​2026
  • SLG community feedback portal opened 9 June to 24 June 2026 ​
  • 325 pieces of feedback comprising 235 formal survey responses, 69 social media, 21+ emails (to date)
  • 80% of survey respondents support Eastern Bay (in the absence of the status quo);  12% support Eastern + Rotorua; 2% BOP; 2% EBOP + WBOP
  • Industry/business hui on 29 June prompting endorsements for Eastern Bay ​
  • Initial Iwi conversations with Ngāti Tuwharetoa (BOP) Settlement Trust in April/May 2026​
  • Further hui to update Iwi Chairs, Tangata Whenua, Māori Landowners on 30 June 2026​
  • Main themes of feedback regarding joining with Eastern Bay vs Others include:​
    • Retain local voice and strong Māori representation, affordability and efficiencies, fair representation, retention of local services and jobs ​
    • Honouring existing arrangements with Iwi/Tangata Whenua
    • Planning and zoning streamlining with new planning reform
  • Opposition of community to merging with the Bay of Plenty region, mainly due to debt levels of TCC and RLC, likely marginalisations and lower priority of KDC 

 

Kawerau District Council engagement updates:

  • Council pānui 4 June
  • Councul pānui 19 June
  • Industry and business forum presentation 29 June
  • Iwi/Tangata Whenua presentation 30 June
  • Council pānui 3 July

Thank you for having your say. For more information, please visit Council's website or the DIA website Government's Head Start information 

Proposed Plan Change 5 (District Boundary Change Matters)

The Council formally adopted the Proposed Plan Change 5 for public notification on Wednesday, 3 June 2026. This is the formal process required under Resource Management Act (RMA) for submissions and hearing, Landowners impacted by Plan Change 5, and the public may only make submissions on the matters being changed in the District Plan. between 5 June and 5 July 2026.

The PUBLIC NOTICE for Proposed Plan Change 5 outlines the proposed changes, how landowners and the community can make a submission and the process following submissions. 

All information regarding Proposed Plan Change 5 including maps, information and Section 32 Report is available online here. Copies are also available at the Council Office. 

Submissions must be made using the formal online survey  or the print-ready submission form. Printed submission forms are also available at the Council Office in Ranfurly Court, Kawerau.

For any queries, please contact Council's Planner on 073069009.  

Draft Annual Plan 2026/27

Submissions are now closed for the Draft Annual Plan 2026-2027. The 31 submissions were tabled at the Hearing on 3 June 2026. Further deliberations will be held on Wednesday, 10 June at an Extraordinary Meeting at 11:00am. 

Consultation topics:

  • 5.8% rates increase
  • Keeping the Uniform Annual General Charge (UAGC) at $900 or reducing the UAGC to $850

Thank you to everyone who submitted, gave feedback or attended one of the consultation meetings. 

Kawerau District Age-Friendly and Accessible Strategy 

The Age-Friendly and Accessible Strategy is reviewed regularly and is a ‘living document’ (meaning that actions taken will be referenced by Kawerau District Council). We are open to any and all suggestions that can help to improve the livelihood and wellbeing of seniors in the Kawerau community. 

 Find out more and have your say here.  

Kawerau District former consultation topics (now closed): 

  • Waste Management and Minimisation Plan - submissions closed Sunday 20 July, 2025. A hearing for submitters will take place, Wednesday 30 July 2025.
  • Local Water Done Well - the decision of the best way to deliver water services to the community closed on Friday, 23 May 2025 A hearing for submitters was held on Wednesday 18 June 2025.
  • Mahere Iwa Tau | Long Term Plan 2025-2034 submissions closed on Monday, 12 May 2025. Hearing 28 May 2025 and adoption 25 June 2025.
  • Our Places - Eastern Bay of Plenty Spatial Plan - submissions closed 9 June 2025.
  • Draft Gambling Venues Policy - submissions closed 16 May. A hearing for submitters was held on Wednesday 11 June 2025
  • Draft Easter Sunday Trading Policy - submissions closed 17 March, 2025.
  • Draft Freedom Camping Bylaw - submissions closed 20 December, 2024. The hearing for submitters was held 26 February 2025
  • Draft Freedom Camping Bylaw - submissions closed 20 December, 2024. The hearing for submitters was held 26 February 2025
  • Representation Review Final Proposal - submissions closed 4 November, 2024. 
  • Proposed Naming Policy - submissions closed 6 September, 2024. The hearing for submitters was held 25 September 2024
  • Draft Freedom Camping Bylaw - submissions closed 6 September, 2024. The hearing for submitters was held 25 September 2024
  • Representation Review initial proposal - submissions closed 5pm, Monday 26 August, 2024. The hearing for submitters was held 11 September 2024
  • Draft Dangerous, Affected and Insanitary Buildings Policy - submissions closed 5pm on Friday 19 July 2024
  • Mahere ā tau | Proposed Annual Plan 2024-2025 - Council adopted the Annual Plan 2024-2025 on Wednesday 26 June 2024.
    • Adopted Mahere ā tau | Annual Plan 2024-2025
  • Rate Remission Policy - Sport, Recreation, and Community Organisations leasing Council land- submissions closed Friday 14 June 2024 and Council adopted the policy on 26 June 2024. 
    • Rate Remission Policy
  • Stoneham Park Residential Development District Plan Modifications - round two of submissions for the District Plan Change 4 closed 28 April 2023; the hearing held 15 June 2023. On 28 July 2023, Council lodged the Proposed District Plan Change 4 final appeal process which was completed without any appeals. The District Plan Change 4 became operative in November 2023.   
  • Stoneham Park Residential Development Reserve Swap - submissions closed 5pm on Friday 24 March 2023. The meeting for submitters was held 26 April 2023.

Eastern Bay Consultation Topics (now closed) are:

  • Kawerau District Proposed Boundary Changes - Submissions closed on 31 March 2023
  • Draft Local Alcohol Policy consultation and submission period closed on Friday 28 April 2023 
  • Bay of Plenty Civil Defence Emergency Management Group Plan and submission period closed Sunday13 August 2023
  • Bay of Plenty Regional Council Representation Review 2024- Submissions closed 10 July 2024. A hearing is scheduled for 13 August 2024
  • Eastern Bay of Plenty Our Places - Spatial Plan -Submissions closed 17 November 2024

Central Government Consultation Topics (now closed):

  • Sale and Supply of Alcohol (Community Participation) Amendment Bill Public Submissions CLOSED on 12 February 2023 Find out more here

  • Natural and Built Environment Bill submissions via Council CLOSED 14 February 2023 Find out more here

  • Spatial Planning Bill Public submissions via Council CLOSED 14 February 2023 Find out more here

  • Water Services Legislation Bill - Three Waters: Public submissions CLOSED 12 February 2023 Find out more here 

  • Water Services - Three Waters Economic Efficiency and Consumer Protection Bill: Public submissions CLOSED 12 February 2023 Find out more here

  • Te Aoratake i te Anamata mō Ngā Kaunihera | Review into the Future for Local Government - Find out more here.
